data.hook: Green Bay fans watched in disbelief as their team blew a 22-10 lead, falling 39-22 to the Vikings in the season opener. It's now the longest losing streak in 35 years, fueling intense talk about coach Matt LaFleur.
data.name: Packers Fans Debate LaFleur's Future After Six-Game Skid
data.summary: The Packers have lost six straight games dating back to late 2025, including playoffs, with repeated collapses after holding double-digit leads. LaFleur acknowledged the late-game issues Monday, defending his aggressive calls while calling for better execution. Fans are split—some demand change despite his recent extension, others urge patience amid high expectations in Green Bay. Analysts say he's not among early firing favorites as the 0-1 team faces the Jets next.

data.hook: With the Packers up 22-17, Matt LaFleur wiped a 40-yard field goal off the board for a bold fourth-and-1 gamble. It backfired when Jordan Love's sneak came up short, sparking the Vikings' comeback.
data.name: LaFleur Stands by Failed Fourth-and-1 Call in Packers Loss
data.summary: Early in the fourth quarter against the Minnesota Vikings, Green Bay's rookie kicker nailed a 40-yard field goal, but a Vikings penalty gave coach Matt LaFleur fourth-and-1 at a prime spot. He opted to go for it instead of extending the lead to eight points, aiming for a two-score advantage that he said changes a game's complexion. Love was stuffed on the sneak, and Minnesota responded with 29 straight points for a 39-22 win amid Packers' turnovers and penalties. LaFleur stands firm after film review, citing past success with sneaks, while fans debate play calls like a tush push amid red-zone woes.

data.hook: After a quick stint on the practice squad, Bo Melton is back with the Green Bay Packers' main squad, ready to add wide receiver depth following their Week 1 loss.
data.name: Packers Sign Bo Melton to Active Roster, Release Scott Daly
data.summary: The Packers signed wide receiver Bo Melton, a 27-year-old Rutgers alum, to their 53-man active roster on September 14, while releasing long snapper Scott Daly from the practice squad. Melton had played in the season-opening loss to the Vikings, catching a pass and handling kick returns after an earlier elevation. With Matt Orzech now fully available at long snapper, Melton's promotion fills the spot and bolsters receiver depth as Green Bay prepares for Week 2. Fans noted the move as a solid, routine adjustment after the defeat.

data.hook: Trailing 22-10 late in the third, the Vikings unleashed a furious rally capped by rookie Domonique 'Big Citrus' Orange stuffing Jordan Love on fourth-and-1.
data.name: Vikings Stage 29-Point Comeback to Beat Packers 39-22
data.summary: Minnesota overcame a big deficit with 29 straight points, powered by Carson Wentz's three touchdown passes in relief of injured Kyler Murray and Orange's game-sealing stop. Jordan Love threw for 387 yards and two scores for Green Bay but faltered with a turnover and fumble amid the collapse. The win starts the Vikings 1-0 while piling pressure on Packers coach Matt LaFleur after their sixth straight loss; Murray's status for Week 2 remains day-to-day.
